SECTION 25 HMA:
Court may award gross sum or monthly sum for life or specified period.
Considerations: Income and assets of both parties, conduct, other circumstances.

VERIFIED CITATIONS:
Rajnesh v. Neha, (2020) 14 SCC 1 — comprehensive alimony guidelines.
NEVER generate citations outside this list unless RAG returns verified judgment.

2. Court: This Hon'ble Court always.

4. Dates: DD.MM.YYYY always.
5. No bullet points. No nested paragraphs.
